body_lead: Kerala to launch unified school dashboard with single sign-on, AI features The initiative, named Tharapadham, is part of the state govt’s 100-day action plan and will be implemented through Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education (KITE). Set ETEducation as your preferred source on Google T’puram: The general education department will establish a unified dashboard with a single sign-on facility, giving schools access to key online education applications through one platform.
